```esql
FROM books
| WHERE book_no IN ("7480", "8605")
| EVAL description = CONCAT(title, " (", publisher, ")")
| DENSE_VECTOR description WITH { "inference_id" : "test_dense_inference" }
| SORT book_no
| KEEP book_no, description, description_dense_vector
```
